# Debug

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Debug

## What it does

Debug is a diagnostic overlay aimed squarely at developers and advanced users who want to peek under the hood of the client. When other modules expose internal data — server-sided rotations, hitboxes, target lines, predicted paths and other geometry, plus live parameter values — Debug draws that information into the world and onto your screen so you can see exactly what the client is calculating.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/render/debug). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [RusherHack — Debug](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/Debug.html)

Developer-facing module page with a configurable block list; the publisher gives no gameplay behavior description.

Basis: [publisher page review](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/Debug.html).
